# Wase Download

> Self-hosted file conversion with static instructions in 13 languages. No account or third-party conversion API key. Read-only MCP discovers declared capabilities; file upload is a separate user-authorized operation.

The public build declares 885 inputs, 517 outputs and 143995 directional combinations. 2681 published directions have representative-fixture HTTP evidence. Declarations and fixture success do not guarantee arbitrary files. Server processing accepts up to 100 MiB per file; the app permits 20 files per batch, processed individually. Optional browser image processing has separate, narrower limits.

## Documentation

- [Formats](https://wase.download/en/formats/): human-readable tested pages and declared format directory.
- [Developers](https://wase.download/en/developers/): HTTP upload API and read-only MCP.
- [API and agent guide](https://wase.download/api-guide.md): exact requests, response handling, limits, errors and file privacy.
- [Public catalogue](https://wase.download/formats.json): input-dependent declared targets; no uploaded files.
- [Representative-tested directions](https://wase.download/verified-conversions.json): complete published pair list and evidence boundary.
- [Privacy](https://wase.download/en/privacy/): server deletion, browser processing and optional analytics.
- [Sitemap](https://wase.download/sitemap.xml): canonical pages admitted for web indexing.

- [Expanded plain-text guide](https://wase.download/llms-full.txt): API guide, language navigation and representative examples in one document.

This llms.txt is a voluntary community-format navigation aid, not a provider registry or guarantee of indexing, ranking or citations. MCP endpoint: https://wase.download/api/mcp (list_formats, conversion_info). Metadata discovery does not upload files; remote URL conversion is not implemented.
